description: What a browser actually puts on the clipboard: a <style> block, pretty-printed indentation, a class that carries styling this crate cannot see, and entities
notes: Decodes to 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.\nCafé - naive - 50%' with the accents intact - the indentation and the newlines inside the paragraphs collapse to single spaces, and the <style> block's text is not text. p.x{color:green} is NOT applied: there is no cascade, which is the documented ceiling.
